footnotes.footnote: This filing is part 4 of 4 Form 4 filings submitted by the Reporting Person on 11/10/2026 to report transactions occurring on 11/06/2026. Due to EDGAR line-item limits, the remaining transactions are reported on additional Form 4s filed concurrently herewith.

On November 6, 2026, Roku, Inc. ("Roku" or the "Company") and Fox Corporation ("FOX") completed the transactions contemplated by the Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement"), dated as of June 14, 2026, by and among Roku, Fox, Falcon Merger Sub 1, Inc. ("Merger Sub 1") and Falcon Merger Sub 2, LLC ("Merger Sub 2") (the "Mergers"). Pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, each share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock of Roku (together, "Company Common Stock") held by the Reporting Person that was outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time (as defined in the Merger Agreement) was converted into the right to receive (A) 0.9799 shares of FOX Class A Common Stock (together with cash in lieu of fractional shares), without interest, and (B) $95.30 in cash, without interest (together, the "Merger Consideration").

Pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, immediately prior to the Effective Time, each option to purchase Company Common Stock ("Company Option") that was an In-the-Money Company Option (as defined in the Merger Agreement) and that was vested, outstanding and unexercised immediately prior to the Effective Time (each, a "Vested In-the-Money Company Option") was cancelled and automatically converted into the right to receive, without interest and subject to deduction for any required withholding, for each share of Company Common Stock subject to such Vested In-the-Money Company Option immediately prior to the Effective Time, the Merger Consideration reduced by the applicable per share exercise price for such Vested In-the-Money Company Option, which was paid in the same proportion of FOX Class A Common Stock and cash as the Merger Consideration (the "Vested Company Option Consideration").

The value of Merger Consideration for purposes of determining the Vested Company Option Consideration was determined based on the closing trading price of FOX Class A Common Stock on November 5, 2026.

Pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, immediately prior to the Effective Time, each Company Option that was an Out-of-the-Money Company Option (as defined in the Merger Agreement) and that was outstanding and unexercised immediately prior to the Effective Time was cancelled as of the Effective Time for no consideration.
Each RSU represented a contingent right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock of the Company.

Pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, immediately prior to the Effective Time, each unvested restricted stock unit of the Company outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time (each, an "Unvested Company RSU") was cancelled and converted into the right to receive (i) a Converted RSU Cash Award and (ii) a Converted RSU Equity Award. Each "Converted RSU Cash Award" provides the holder with the right to receive a payment in respect of each share of Company Common Stock that was subject to the applicable Unvested Company RSU immediately prior to the Effective Time equal to the Per Share Cash Amount.

Payment of the Converted RSU Cash Award may be made in the form of cash or FOX Class A Common Stock, or a combination thereof, as determined by FOX in its sole discretion, with the value of the FOX Class A Common Stock determined based on the closing trading price of FOX Class A Common Stock on the last trading day immediately prior to the date on which the Converted RSU Cash Award is paid, and are subject to any required withholding. Each "Converted RSU Equity Award" is an award of restricted stock units that provides the holder with the right to receive a number of shares of FOX Class A Common Stock equal to the product of (rounded to the nearest whole number of shares): (i) the number of shares of Company Common Stock subject to such Unvested Company RSU immediately prior to the Effective Time multiplied by (ii) the Exchange Ratio.
